usage: The word '頭痛' (tau4 tung3) is used as a noun to refer to the physical symptom of a headache.
'頭痛' can describe both mild and severe pain in the head area.
In a sentence, '頭痛' usually follows verbs like '有' (to have) or '感覺' (to feel) when describing the experience.
You can also use '頭痛' to emphasize the cause of discomfort, e.g., '呢啲嘢令我頭痛' means 'This stuff gives me a headache'.
Adding an adverb before '頭痛', such as '好' (very), can indicate the intensity of the headache.
